name: River Cahn
source:
River is the youngest daughter of [url=/c64114]Craig[/url] and Ashley and the younger sister of Briar and Hazel. She most often accompanies Craig during his daily runs, providing support while strapped to his chest. Craig will often move River's hands for her to wave to others or to cheer himself on. River does not seem to mind this.

[From the [url=https://dreamdaddy.fandom.com/wiki/River]Wiki[/url].]
